specifications.statement: Attached storage: one to six chains; each chain contains up to six HDD-only or SSD-capable disk shelves, combined in any order. No shelf/cable model or wiring topology is stated here. [HTML #ZFSRE-GUID-6D3F47EA-7D39-46CC-B484-3CC3BF6671DB; article paragraphs 1]

Fan-module fault indications: front/rear Service Action Required LEDs, front Fan Module Service Action Required (TOP) LED, and Fan Fault LED on/adjacent to faulty module. System Overtemp LED might also light if temperature rises. [HTML #ZFSRE-GUID-23D9E421-97EA-4692-B197-0F5E78A142A3; article paragraphs 37,39,40,41,42]

Two fan power boards are FRUs; power fan modules, carry status LEDs and transfer I2C fan-module data. Two refers to boards, not fan-module quantity. [HTML #ZFSRE-GUID-23D9E421-97EA-4692-B197-0F5E78A142A3; article paragraphs 19]

Documented configuration/cluster rule in dated OS8.8.x manual, not installed-unit inventory: Two system boot drives in slots 0 and 1 form a mirrored pair; up to four read-optimized cache SSDs can populate slots 2–5 in order. In a Sun ZFS Storage 7420 clustered configuration, both controllers SSD counts must match. [HTML #ZFSRE-GUID-23D9E421-97EA-4692-B197-0F5E78A142A3; article paragraphs 22]

Six-drive backplane is a FRU with drive connectors, I/O-board interconnect, Power/Locator buttons and status LEDs; this is not an installed-drive count. [HTML #ZFSRE-GUID-23D9E421-97EA-4692-B197-0F5E78A142A3; article paragraphs 20]

Vertical PDB Card, also called vertical power distribution board or Paddle Card, is a FRU interconnecting PDB with fan power boards, hard-drive backplane and I/O board. [HTML #ZFSRE-GUID-23D9E421-97EA-4692-B197-0F5E78A142A3; article paragraphs 17]

Power Distribution Board is a FRU: distributes main 12V from supplies; connects to Vertical PDB, motherboard bus bar/ribbon cable and top-cover interlock kill switch. power supplies → power supply backplane → power distribution board topology is explicitly described. [HTML #ZFSRE-GUID-23D9E421-97EA-4692-B197-0F5E78A142A3; article paragraphs 16]

Power Supply Backplane Card connects the PDB to power supplies 0 and 1. These are named connection positions; no PSU model, rating or redundancy inference is supplied. [HTML #ZFSRE-GUID-23D9E421-97EA-4692-B197-0F5E78A142A3; article paragraphs 18]

SP subsystem controls host power and monitors host events. SP controller uses host 3.3V standby rail whenever AC input is present, even when system is off. [HTML #ZFSRE-GUID-23D9E421-97EA-4692-B197-0F5E78A142A3; article paragraphs 15]

System Overtemp LED might also light if temperature rises. [HTML #ZFSRE-GUID-23D9E421-97EA-4692-B197-0F5E78A142A3; article paragraphs 37,39,40,41,42]

context_facts.name: cooling_description
context_facts.value: Two fan power boards are FRUs; power fan modules, carry status LEDs and transfer I2C fan-module data. Two refers to boards, not fan-module quantity. [HTML #ZFSRE-GUID-23D9E421-97EA-4692-B197-0F5E78A142A3; article paragraphs 19]

context_facts.name: physical_description
context_facts.value: Documented configuration/cluster rule in dated OS8.8.x manual, not installed-unit inventory: Two system boot drives in slots 0 and 1 form a mirrored pair; up to four read-optimized cache SSDs can populate slots 2–5 in order. In a Sun ZFS Storage 7420 clustered configuration, both controllers SSD counts must match. [HTML #ZFSRE-GUID-23D9E421-97EA-4692-B197-0F5E78A142A3; article paragraphs 22]

context_facts.name: physical_description
context_facts.value: Six-drive backplane is a FRU with drive connectors, I/O-board interconnect, Power/Locator buttons and status LEDs; this is not an installed-drive count. [HTML #ZFSRE-GUID-23D9E421-97EA-4692-B197-0F5E78A142A3; article paragraphs 20]

context_facts.name: physical_description
context_facts.value: Vertical PDB Card, also called vertical power distribution board or Paddle Card, is a FRU interconnecting PDB with fan power boards, hard-drive backplane and I/O board. [HTML #ZFSRE-GUID-23D9E421-97EA-4692-B197-0F5E78A142A3; article paragraphs 17]

context_facts.name: power_description
context_facts.value: Power Distribution Board is a FRU: distributes main 12V from supplies; connects to Vertical PDB, motherboard bus bar/ribbon cable and top-cover interlock kill switch. power supplies → power supply backplane → power distribution board topology is explicitly described. [HTML #ZFSRE-GUID-23D9E421-97EA-4692-B197-0F5E78A142A3; article paragraphs 16]

context_facts.name: power_description
context_facts.value: Power Supply Backplane Card connects the PDB to power supplies 0 and 1. These are named connection positions; no PSU model, rating or redundancy inference is supplied. [HTML #ZFSRE-GUID-23D9E421-97EA-4692-B197-0F5E78A142A3; article paragraphs 18]

context_facts.name: power_description
context_facts.value: SP subsystem controls host power and monitors host events. SP controller uses host 3.3V standby rail whenever AC input is present, even when system is off. [HTML #ZFSRE-GUID-23D9E421-97EA-4692-B197-0F5E78A142A3; article paragraphs 15]

context_facts.name: service_restriction_as_printed
context_facts.value: Field-replaceable units should only be replaced by trained Oracle service technicians. [HTML #ZFSRE-GUID-23D9E421-97EA-4692-B197-0F5E78A142A3; article paragraphs 14]
